field_units.structure_only_versatiles: VersaTiles for 486 logic bits excluding one-off circuitry

context.implementation: native primitives, one structure per standalone project; post-layout STA with back-annotated delays
context.workload: complete dual 243-bit shift-register test chain (486 logic bits), common 10-stage BUFD upstream-chain design, one calibration ring oscillator per project
context.constraints: 30 MHz reference clock (33.333 ns reported); identical project comparison flow
context.area_variability: Source states synthesized occupancy identical in three runs; input retains exact reported count, without physical area error bars
context.timing_variability: Observed min-max of three independent place-and-route runs, not confidence intervals or guaranteed future-run enclosures
context.excluded: Merged irradiation-project Table 11 timing, radiation cross-sections, zero-event upper limits and Weibull fit uncertainty are not objectives or interval bounds

unresolved: Exact place-and-route seed values and complete synthesis/settings command lines not available
Raw HDL, implementation reports and individual run frequencies not obtained
Protection equivalence is unverified and must not be inferred from cost compatibility
verification.source_access: Publisher HTML Tables9-10 numerically checked; PDF not available. No original HDL/raw run reports reconstructed.

analysis_plan_before_run.objectives: Minimize cells=published VersaTiles per logic bit and period_ns=1000/fmax_mean_mhz; endpoints=1000/fmax_max_mhz,1000/fmax_min_mhz
analysis_plan_before_run.period_warning: Reciprocal of mean frequency is neither mean period nor source mean critical-path delay; those quantities are not substituted
analysis_plan_before_run.base_scope: all six published designs, cost only
analysis_plan_before_run.secondary_scopes: TMR-based five designs and SET-suppression four designs are explicitly selected architecture portfolios; they do not assert equal radiation performance or verified coverage
analysis_plan_before_run.budget_grid: cells caps 20,30,40 bracket reported costs 11-37 in round 10-cell tiers; frequency requirements 30,32,40,50 MHz span reported performance. 30 MHz is source reference; 32,40,50 MHz and all cell caps are analyst-selected what-if requirements, not certified device/mission limits
analysis_plan_before_run.scale_rationale: A dimensionless t increases each half-width by t VersaTiles/bit and t ns; simple stated unit sensitivity, not fitted uncertainty, probability or physical variation
